players.name: Filip Gustavsson
players.note: Gustavsson (hip) was placed on long-term injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Ivan Demidov
players.note: Demidov (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Canadiens on Tuesday, per the NHL media site.

players.name: Mathew Barzal
players.note: Barzal (knee) will not join the Islanders for their two-game road trip, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports Thursday.

players.name: Seth Jarvis
players.note: Jarvis (shoulder) said Friday that he plans to travel with the Hurricanes during their upcoming five-game road trip, Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News reports.

players.name: Travis Konecny
players.note: Konecny (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to the NHL media site.

players.name: Pavel Zacha
players.note: Zacha (undisclosed) left Friday's game versus the Ducks in the third period after taking a hit, and there was no update on his status after the contest, Scott McLaughlin of WEEI reports.
